authorityBoundary: Visual-recognition study support only. Current AASM Scoring Manual Version 3 governs staging, scoring, cardiac, respiratory, movement, technical, and reporting rules; ICSD-3-TR governs current diagnostic classification; current AASM/AAST guidance, facility policy, and manufacturer instructions govern testing procedures, safety, and treatment-related decisions. Legacy 2010 rules and protocol details must not override current authority.
copyrightUse: Use bibliographic metadata, chapter/appendix titles, page locators, waveform/event-recognition themes, and original Sleep Pathways Guild study directions only. Do not reproduce proprietary tracings, figures, tables, images, or substantial protected prose.
